t: Section 322(d)(4) is amended by striking “2017” and inserting “2019”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that changes a date from 2017 to 2019 in an existing provision. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a technical amendment that changes a specific year in a statute. It does not establish any process for consultation, public comment, advisory boards, or coordination with outside parties. It is purely a legislative update to a date.
qwen_block.s: Section 322(d)(4) is amended by striking “2017” and inserting “2019”.
